pairs.subject: terminal-multiplexing
pairs.evidence: src/components/cli/TerminalOutput/useTerminalOutput.ts:15 Per-session view state (expanded tool groups/pairs, selection) is held in the widget's own useState, so it survives parking (display:none) but is lost whenever the ModuleRenderer session LRU evicts and later remounts the terminal; the technique requires the manager to keep this state per session identity across detach as well as park.

techniques.evidence: src/components/cli/TerminalOutput/useTerminalOutput.ts:15 View state lives in the widget, not in the session-keyed manager (cliPanelStore), so it does not outlive the view on detach.

src/components/cli/TerminalOutput/index.tsx:95 Output is DOM rows with content-visibility skipping offscreen paint. There is no GPU/WebGL renderer or glyph atlas, so there is no counted context to budget.
src/components/cli/TerminalOutput/index.tsx:12 The view consumes structured LogEntry events (stream-json lane). A repo-wide search for node-pty/xterm/ConPTY found no pseudo-terminal.

src/components/cli/TerminalOutput/helpers.tsx:54 The occupant emits typed lifecycle events (tool_use/tool_result), so no screen classification is needed. The technique says not to build it in that case.
src/components/cli/TerminalOutput/useTerminalOutput.ts:93 Actions dispatch a whole prompt string as a new task, not keystrokes into a device. There is no key notation to own.
